lines.text: What are professional baseball bats actually made of?
One solid piece of wood. Mostly ash, maple or birch.
The rulebook caps the length at forty-two inches.
And the thickest part can only be two point six one inches wide.
Metal is fine in college ball, but in the pros, it is wood only.
